quotes.text: That's not a co-pilot failure. That's what happens when you deploy a 2026 AI capability on top of a 2010 knowledge architecture and expect the model to sort it out.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp framing that weak Copilot results are an architecture problem.

quotes.text: Copilot doesn't create the exposure problem. It makes the existing exposure problem trivially exploitable. One prompt and the semantic retrieval layer goes looking for anything relevant across every piece of content within that user's permission boundary.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains precisely how Copilot amplifies existing oversharing.

quotes.text: In a knowledge graph architecture, metadata is an AI safety control. The decisions you make about site structures, content types, and managed metadata columns don't just affect discoverability.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes metadata from admin chore to AI safety control.

quotes.text: Rag without good metadata retrieves poorly. Metadata without rag relies on generic model knowledge. These aren't competing approaches or alternatives you choose between. They're dependent layers that only work when both are present.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise statement of the dependency between RAG and metadata.

quotes.text: The fix isn't to model less carefully. It's to ship something before perfecting everything. A minimal ontology supporting one working use case outperforms a comprehensive ontology supporting zero.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable recommendation against boil-the-ocean ontology projects.

chapters.title: Knowledge graphs and metadata as foundation
Governance and hardening the semantic layer

takeaways: Weak Copilot answers usually stem from the knowledge architecture underneath: unstructured content, missing metadata and overly broad permissions, not the model itself.
A governed knowledge graph on top of Microsoft Graph, with a metadata schema, a minimal viable ontology, entity resolution and metadata-first RAG, turns retrieval into trustworthy answers.
Governance must run as a continuous operational discipline, starting with a SharePoint Data Access Governance audit and one narrow, measurable use case before scaling.
hook: Copilot often feels like a slightly smarter search bar because it runs on a decade-old knowledge architecture. This episode is for IT pros and decision makers who want Copilot to reason over trusted, governed organizational knowledge. Learn how to design metadata, ontology, permissions and ingestion for a scalable Microsoft 365 knowledge graph.
